That's It For The Other One

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Doin' That Rag** (2 reviews): The reviewer singles out this performance as great; Tight, nicely jammed, with great vocals; reviewer can't name a better version [5][10]
- **Cryptical Envelopment** (2 reviews): Strong first Cryptical, then the second Cryptical reprise is called absolutely gorgeous, ending the first set; Reviewer calls it a wicked Cryptical, perhaps second or third best ever [12][14]
- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Reviewer picks the Dark Star into Lovelight stretch as a standout; Reviewer says it sent their mind drifting into outer space [7][12]
- **He Was A Friend Of Mine** (2 reviews): Noted because the song was performed only about a dozen times; Called one of the best versions in the catalog [9][15]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Opens the show nicely, leading into an energetic early Me and My Uncle [12]
- **Me and My Uncle** (1 review): Described as a ferocious version, played the way the song should be [10]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China Cat into Sittin' On Top Of The World is called outstanding, along with Dark Star and The Eleven [9]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): Playing steps up at The Eleven and stays elevated through Lovelight, making the show special [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **He Was A Friend**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]

## The recordings

- **gd69-06-05.sbd.cotsman.15204.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 16 songs; 140 min; rated 4.38/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the sound somewhat flat and recalls an early hissy cassette copy; Says the hiss others mentioned is not a concern; sound is good; Reviewer finds the sound strong but suggests adding some bass with the equalizer [1][5][7][10][11][15]
- **gd1969-06-05.sbd.barbella.6017.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 145 min; rated 2.33/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1969-06-05.135518.sbd.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 13 songs; 141 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1969-06-05.135483.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 13 songs; 141 min; rated 3/5 by 5 [4]

## Around the show

- That's It For The Other One judged as strong as the versions from 2/28/69 and 5/2/70 [9]
- Compared to the Hollywood, Florida shows weeks earlier: equally good but less manic [15]
- Reviewer sees it as classic 1969 Dead, mixing songs from the new album with heavier pieces [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-06-05.sbd.cotsman.15204.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by JCotsman; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: A probable second patch from another soundboard lies in the second-set jam, since no tape flips are audible [1]
- **gd1969-06-05.sbd.barbella.6017.shnf**: transferred by EAC>SHN by Steve Barbella from Audio Discs contributed by Seth Kaplan; source: MSC>LATVALA C>DAT>CD>EAC>SHN [2]. Also: Two soundboard masters exist, on reels and cassettes; together they contain the complete show; One master lacks six minutes of the Cryptical reprise; the other starts just after The Other One begins; Composites and partial or unpatched fragments of That's It For The Other One circulate, so collectors should beware [2]
- **gd1969-06-05.135518.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (48k) [3]
- **gd1969-06-05.135483.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (48k) [4]
